# saas_kit v3.0.0 - Table of Contents

> A package for running the code generators from Live SAAS kit.

## Modules

- [SaasKit.API](https://saas-kit.hexdocs.pm/SaasKit.API.md): Thin wrapper around the livesaaskit.com HTTP API.
- [SaasKit.AgentSkills](https://saas-kit.hexdocs.pm/SaasKit.AgentSkills.md): Installs optional SaaS Kit guidance for common coding assistants.

- [SaasKit.Decisions](https://saas-kit.hexdocs.pm/SaasKit.Decisions.md): Resolves feature decisions exposed by the Live SaaS Kit API.
- [SaasKit.ProjectConfig](https://saas-kit.hexdocs.pm/SaasKit.ProjectConfig.md): Manages local SaaS Kit project state.

- [SaasKit.Task.Helpers](https://saas-kit.hexdocs.pm/SaasKit.Task.Helpers.md): Shared helpers for SaaS Kit Mix tasks.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix saaskit.feature.install](https://saas-kit.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Saaskit.Feature.Install.md): Installs a SaaS Kit feature.
- [mix saaskit.feature.list](https://saas-kit.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Saaskit.Feature.List.md): Lists all available SaaS Kit features and their installation status.
- [mix saaskit.feature.show](https://saas-kit.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Saaskit.Feature.Show.md): Shows full detail for a single SaaS Kit feature.
- [mix saaskit.help](https://saas-kit.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Saaskit.Help.md): Displays getting-started information and all available SaaS Kit mix tasks.
- [mix saaskit.plan.install](https://saas-kit.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Saaskit.Plan.Install.md): Installs a SaaS Kit plan with multiple plans.
- [mix saaskit.setup](https://saas-kit.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Saaskit.Setup.md): Installs the initial SaaS Kit feature and creates local project state.
- [mix saaskit.status](https://saas-kit.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Saaskit.Status.md): Reports current SaaS Kit state: config status, app name, installed/pending
feature counts, and the suggested next command.
